step_dag.name: census
step_dag.acceptance: board_view and counts quoted as the before-state

step_dag.name: closure sweep
step_dag.acceptance: every step and work order whose evidence shows done is driven through the lifecycle; each closure cites its evidence Closures on steps owned by other seats are dispatched to those owners and their validators; the orchestrator personally closes only her own steps and coordinates the sweep (AGENTS.md 3.7). The sweep is driven by the closure verbs' next_ready returns: each closure's named next item is worked, or its block cited, in the same pass.

step_dag.name: duplicate / debris review
step_dag.acceptance: duplicates cancelled with reason; test and drill artifacts are cancelled leaves-up with their origin named in the cancellation reason (the 2026-11-22 cleanup pattern) - nothing is moved to a battery project, and debris a run creates is cleaned by that same run; no debris remains in production tasks

step_dag.name: gates record review
step_dag.acceptance: every gate on the gates record re-read against current direction; a gate whose lifting conditions are met is surfaced for its authority's ruling, never lifted by hygiene

step_dag.name: close with the census diff
step_dag.acceptance: closure carries the census diff (before/after counts)
